en-US.description:
When a fire breaks out, rather than blindly running outside,

📍 Evacuating according to your surroundings is the most important thing!

✅ When evacuation is possible

① 😷 Cover your nose and mouth with a wet handkerchief or clothing

② 📢 Notify people inside the house of the fire

③ 🧎‍♂️ Evacuate to the ground floor or rooftop using the stairs in a low posture

④ 🚪 Make sure to close doors during evacuation + 🚫 Do not use the elevator

⑤ 🔔 Press the emergency bell and call 📞 119 from a safe place

❗ When evacuation is impossible

① 😷 Cover your nose and mouth with a wet handkerchief or clothing

② 📢 Notify people inside the house of the fire

③ 🏠 Move to an evacuation space, lightweight partition, or downward escape hatch

🚨 What if you don't know of an evacuation space?

① 🚪 Move away from flames and smoke, then close the door.

🧻 Block door gaps with a wet towel, etc.

② 📞 Call 119 to report your current location and situation, and request rescue.

💬 ‘Fire Evacuation Guidelines’ presented by Daeng-i

en-US.title: [#NationalBehaviorGuidelines] Accidents caused by crowds of people ⚠️ If you're not properly prep...
en-US.description:
Unexpected crowd accidents...

What should we do in such a moment? 🤔

Small amounts of attention and preparation can prevent critical situations and keep everyone safe! ☝️

To keep everyone safe even in emergency situations,
💬 Learn together through the video "Citizens' Guidelines for Preparing for Crowd Accidents" from Dang-eun! 📢

✅ Citizens' Guidelines for Preparing for Crowd Accidents
① Before visiting crowded places
Check the congestion level and surrounding routes in advance
② When visiting crowded places
Keep on the right for safety
Be careful on narrow streets and slopes, as accidents are more likely to occur
Run away immediately if your walking speed slows or your body touches someone
If you feel unsafe, call 112 or 119
③ If you're trapped in a crowd
If you're with children, hold them or protect them with your shoulder
Cover them with both hands in front of your chest to ensure breathing space
If you fall, cover your head and curl up into a ball to protect yourself

Now, even in crowded places Don't panic,
remember the safety rules and have a safe day!😊
